readSections: Published pp.1–27 completely: introduction, §§1–6, every proof and references.

publicationPreflight.note: Protocols unchanged from the fully read current versions. Core owner documents and coverage unchanged. HE21 merged generic-Hecke routing and the refreshed KPZ26 root route inspected; no active HE18 deliverable or applicable AGENTS file on main.

summary: Source-complete main-paper reading with a declaration-sized extraction of Newton strata, twisted Hecke coinvariants, congruence-level generators, Howe finiteness and the rigid presentation. Partial proof closure: several published assertions need corrected scopes or proofs. In particular finite minimal representatives fail for inversion on a split central torus, distribution duals use products, arbitrary-ring Howe finite generation fails, and overlap graphs require inverse transport. Reuse existing Hecke and local-group owners, extend the existing affine-Coxeter candidate, and propose one distinct Newton-cocenter continuation. Nothing is claimed formalized.

conventions.local: F is a nonarchimedean local field of either characteristic, residue field F_q of characteristic p; G is the F-points of a connected reductive F-group, with maximal F-split torus A, chosen alcove, Iwahori I and pro-p Iwahori I'.
conventions.coefficients: R is a commutative Z[1/p]-algebra, given the discrete topology for test functions. Haar volume is normalized by μ(I')=1. Convolution is NOT the pointwise multiplication instance on compactly supported continuous maps.
conventions.twisting: θ is an automorphism of G preserving A and I, continuous and inducing finite-order actions on the apartment and Iwahori–Weyl group. ω:G→R× has open kernel. T_x f(g)=ω(x)f(x⁻¹gθ(x)); supp(T_x f)=x supp(f) θ(x)⁻¹.
conventions.guard: The phrase finite-minima guard means that the fibre of Ω→Ω_θ over each κ under consideration is finite, for example θ=id. This is a genuine extra scope restriction on the printed finite-minimal-element argument, not an implication of finite order of θ.
conventions.scope: The corrected field Howe targets also require R a field of characteristic different from p and the finite-minima guard. No general-ring dual finite-generation assertion is retained. General twisted Newton partition and rigid presentation remain intended targets with explicit proof gaps, not disproved conclusions.
conventions.baseline: Library means an exact stated ingredient, not an implemented p-adic specialization. All implementationStatus values remain unchecked.

items.statement: For F and G as in the local convention choose A, its affine apartment, an alcove and I. The relative Weyl group is N_G(A)(F)/Z_G(A)(F). Retain the actual minimal Levi Z_G(A), which need not be a torus.
proofSteps: Import algebraic reductive groups and valued relative roots; do not use cocharacters of a nontorus centralizer as if they formed a torus lattice.
acceptance: The split GL2 apartment has one relative root direction and one central direction.
